source.author: ov
source.text: Quem procul astantem plectrumque imbelle tenentem Pettalus irridens Stygiis cane cetera dixit manibus et laevo mucronem tempore fixit.
source.text_original: Quem procul astantem plectrumque imbelle tenentem / Pettalus irridens 'Stygiis cane cetera' dixit / 'manibus' et laevo mucronem tempore fixit.
source.text_english: Pettalus, mocking him as he stood at a distance and held an unmartial plectrum, said, You with the rest of the Stygian hounds, and he drove his point into the left temple.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_original: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat / manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, / siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_english: Then Alcimede was bringing sacred rites to Tartarean Jove and to the Stygian spirits, as an added support for her mighty son, if from the summoned shades she might learn anything better in advance.
